point: G_N is not derived by GR; it is an empirical coupling constant in the Einstein-Hilbert normalization. MTS may derive or constrain its source normalization, but must not pretend calibration is proof.
framework_rule: MTS route: G_N = K_GR[theta0,G_H,M_eff,H,J_mass] at the GR/Newton fixed point, then local residuals are deviations around that calibrated value.

point: Compare MTS residuals against fitted/calibrated GR/Newton baselines, not against an uncalibrated caricature.
framework_rule: This keeps tests fair: constants may be fitted once, but extra horizontal residuals must still pass PPN/R10/clock/WEP/orbital constraints.
